description:
About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we’re building. Listed on the NYSE (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page

About The Team

At Nubank we heavily rely on data, machine learning and other quantitative models & techniques to drive our strategy and provide the best experience and products to our customers. The position holder will be part of the Model Risk team within the Risk Management structure at Nubank. The Model Risk team is the second line of defense for our models. Our mission is to ensure Nubank relies on world‑class solutions that will lead to optimal and sustainable decisions. We act by providing independent review & challenge to models, staying tuned to cutting‑edge techniques, along with business and customers needs. We also work to identify and control risks related to our models and define and implement feedback loops to constantly improve them.

About The Role

  • Provide effective challenges, identify risks and enhancement opportunities, and engage with other Data Scientists and Business Analysts to strengthen our decision‑making tools;
  • Discuss and report model risk status and independent opinions on models with different stakeholders, including senior managers and regulators;
  • Contribute to the consolidation of and improve Nubank’s Model Risk Management and Model Review frameworks with autonomy and creativity;
  • Be exposed to different types of decisions and processes (e.g., credit, fraud, operations and in different countries).
  • Conduct independent reviews of quantitative models based on statistical, machine learning and AI techniques, with a stronger focus on credit models;
  • Develop playbooks and toolkits (Python, Scala, SQL, etc.) to optimize model reviews, ongoing models monitoring, and assess the impact of models in decisions;
  • Ensure the team maintains a high level of technical excellence.

We Are Looking For a Person Who Has

  • Great communication skills: clear, concise and structured.
  • Problem‑solving skills: strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities are essential for identifying risk factors and implementing effective risk management strategies.
  • Experience developing or validating machine learning models used to leverage important decision‑making processes or to solve relevant academic problems.
  • Interest in reviewing complex machine learning and other types of models to identify risks and propose enhancements.
  • Ability to work autonomously and demonstrate a sense of prioritization.
  • Data Science skills, strong knowledge of machine learning tools and techniques.
  • Strong programming skills, desirable previous experience with Python, SQL, GitHub.
  • Stakeholder management and influencing skills across levels.
  • Organized and detail‑oriented, without losing track of the big picture.
  • Advanced English skills.
  • Previous experience in credit risk management and/or other risk management frameworks would be a plus.
  • Master’s degree or relevant undergraduate scientific project would be a plus.
  • Previous knowledge of expected loss provisions modeling would be a plus.

Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank
  • Food/Meal Card (Vale‑Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)
  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale‑Transporte)
  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Nucleo – Our learning platform of courses
  • Extended Parental Leave
  • Daycare Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships
  • 30 days of paid vacation
  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
Overview

About Sierra Studio

When you apply to Sierra, you join an ecosystem. We specialize in connecting talented Brazilian professionals with exciting career opportunities in a highly-vetted small community of growing companies in the US. Applying to Sierra seamlessly integrates you into this ecosystem, granting automatic eligibility for all relevant opportunities we offer.

About our hiring partner

Our hiring partner is a consumer product development company. They help companies make new products & bring them to market, leading concepting, design, engineering, supply chain setup & ongoing operational oversight. They have teams in New York City, Hong Kong and beyond. They work with startups and established companies across many consumer categories; from connected hardware & electronics, to durable housewares and in-home goods, to soft-goods and packaging, and everything in between.

Who our hiring partner is looking for

They are looking for a motivated and hands-on Mechanical Engineer to join their team. This position will provide you with the opportunity to work on exciting development projects, helping to create and bring innovative products to life. You will apply your experience in mechanical design, CAD modeling, prototyping, while working alongside cross-functional teams to ensure the product meets all requirements from concept to production.

The Mechanical Engineer will be a member of our hiring partner's Brazil team - The position can be remote but will report to the Staff Engineer out of Campinas/SP. The Brazil team reports into the Head of Product based in HQ in NYC.

The Candidate

You have experience engineering new products and/or handling touchpoints throughout the concept to manufacturing journey. You've either built or supported bringing new products to the world, handling mechanical engineering design, research, testing, prototyping, and validation.

You have experience working with mass manufactured product and are familiar with a variety of materials. You're willing to research, learn, adapt and take initiative but not afraid of taking on challenges.

The Job

As Mechanical Engineer, you will:

  • Help to lead (and lead) development work from product definition through manufacturing.
  • Communicate progress to team members and project requirements for development and manufacturing.
  • Work closely with NYC and Asia teams to communicate and determine direction & solve development problems as they arise.
  • Collaborate with NY/Asia engineering teams to ensure the engineering designs meet client requirements and design intent.

Responsibilities

  • Assist and lead Mechanical Design: Support the design and development of product by creating 3D CAD models, producing engineering drawings, and necessary documentation. i.e. lead mechanical design engineering of a product from inception to manufacturing.
  • Prototyping & Testing: Build and test prototypes to validate designs, including hands-on assembly and working with external suppliers for prototype development.
  • Ensure efficient product development cycle with detailed prototyping, testing, and validation throughout the process.
  • Ensuring designs align with performance, material, and cost targets determined for each project.
  • Collaborate with Teams: Work closely with the engineering and design teams to ensure that products meet functional, material, and aesthetic goals. Communicate with marketing, operations, and manufacturing teams to align on project updates and requirements.
  • Support and Create Documentation: Assist with maintaining and updating CAD models and related product documentation (3D, 2D, etc.).
  • Product Testing: Help conduct off-tool and in-market sample testing, participate in troubleshooting and debugging design issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Learn from Experienced Engineers: Continue to build experience in various materials and different stages of product development while learning best practices from senior and staff engineers.
  • Support Supply Chain Efforts: Collaborate with the sourcing and supply chain teams to help gather information and support procurement of materials and components. Providing technical feedback and assets to support sourcing & supply chain teams, working closely with manufacturing engineers and suppliers.
  • Handle multiple projects and work independently.
  • Provide Engineering Support and Analysis to NY and HK engineering teams.
  • Build inhouse prototypes or scope external partners to prototype designs.

The Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in product development and mechanical engineering. Must have a portfolio with previously launched and manufactured products.
  • Proven experience within consumer electronics /household appliance industry and related industries focused on mechanical engineering
  • Engineering degree preferably Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Highly proficient and deeply familiar with CAD tools (Solidworks, Onshape, or Creo) and prior experience with a variety of prototyping approaches
  • Hands-on experience with prototyping, 3D printing, or other fabrication tools is a plus.
  • Experience with a wide range of materials (plastics, metals, rubbers) and knowledge informing the material selection process.
  • Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach challenges methodically applying analytical skills with proactive issue resolution- creating and guiding root cause analysis and DOE's.
  • Passion for product development: Interest in consumer product design, manufacturing, and mechanical systems.
  • Strong communication skills: Ability to work well with cross-functional teams and convey technical concepts clearly. Strong Presentation skills - especially conveying technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent project management skills- with experience tracking numerous development projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to travel to Asia including Hong Kong, China, Vietnam, South Korea, and Taiwan.
  • High level proficiency in English language- written and spoken

Working Hours

While our work involves coordination predominantly with NY Team, there are meetings that are scheduled outside of traditional 9-6 working hours to accommodate the HK team. We trust all team members to manage their schedules and to take appropriate measures to take care of themselves and their wellbeing.

The Process

Please submit your resume and we will reach out if there is a potential fit.

Our hiring partner is constantly refining their hiring process to be as inclusive, transparent, and respectful of applicants' time as possible. As part of this process, you may be asked to complete a paid assessment based on the role.

Our hiring partner is an equal opportunity employer. They are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. They firmly believe that a diversity of experience, perspectives, and background lead to a better environment for their employees and to better results for their clients. They strongly encourage diverse candidates to apply.

title: Digital Talent | Bosch Global
description:
How Bosch is training the smartest minds

In the race to secure the best digital talent, Bosch is setting up the “Digital Talent Academy” in Brazil. It trains young people in areas such as software development and artificial intelligence. For many of them, this represents a decisive step toward a different life.

The red logotype is already recognizable from the freeway. Huge letters spelling out BOSCH adorn the main building of the Campinas location in Brazil. Nicolly Cristina Cruz Storoni had often driven past here with her mother. She had never imagined that she could ever work for the company with the red logo. But two years ago, her dream unexpectedly became reality. In July 2021, the then 17-year-old applied for a place at Bosch’s newly established Digital Talent Academy (DTA) in Campinas and prevailed over more than 2,000 candidates. She was among the top 18 who were offered a place in that year’s round of admissions.

Since summer 2021, Nicolly has been studying and working at the Digital Talent Academy at the Bosch location in Campinas, Brazil

My biggest wish is to finish my apprenticeship, buy my own apartment and car, and develop professionally in my career.

YouTube

Loading the video requires your consent. If you agree by clicking on the Play icon, the video will load and data will be transmitted to Google as well as information will be accessed and stored by Google on your device. Google may be able to link these data or information with existing data.

The Digital Talent Academy offers young talents an education with a high practical share directly at Bosch.

The DTA first opened in January 2021. The objective: to train talented young people in a variety of digital skills. These range from intelligent process automation and artificial intelligence to data analysis and software development. “We saw how great the demand is for digital skills at Bosch,” explains Johnny Palma, who first came up with the idea for a digital talent factory. “So together with Henrique Dona, who is responsible for technical training in Campinas, I devised our own training program.” The DTA collaborates with the technical school SENAI (National Industrial Apprenticeship Service) in Campinas. The large theoretical part takes place at SENAI, while the technical and practical side happens at Bosch.

This dual-education model, which has a strong tradition in countries like Germany, is unique in Brazil. Here, assuming one has the financial means to do so, the traditional options are to study or to take part in an apprenticeship program. In Brazil, however, the latter is structured more like school and offers little in the way of practical experience.

Springboard to a better life

For many young Brazilians, the DTA is a springboard to a better life. “We do not selectively filter people by education, experience, or language skills beforehand. Everybody gets the same chance — regardless of their background, gender, or financial means,” says Gaston Diaz Perez, the head of Bosch in Latin America. “We want to make the program accessible for all talented, ambitious young people who share our values.” In this way, Bosch not only gets the country’s top talent, but is also living up to its social responsibility. “If you give them the opportunity to develop and have a better life, we can benefit on all levels — it’s a win for our business and for society,” says Diaz Perez.

Training in software development or artificial intelligence is not only an important step for Nicolly.

applied for admission to the program this year. Thirty-six of them started as apprentices in January 2023.

Nicolly is just one of many examples that prove that what matters most here is ability. “I was surprised they accepted me,” she admits. “Who takes on a young single mother?” When she applied, her daughter was just six months old. Nicolly’s mother was skeptical about whether she would be able to handle so many responsibilities, but she still encouraged her daughter to go for it. And Nicolly was a standout — in a three-stage selection procedure consisting of an IQ test, group work, and a face-to-face interview. “At the interview stage, we find out who has the potential and the determination to develop here,” says Henrique Dona. “Most students start out not speaking a word of English or knowing how to program. Today they’re presenting their project work to members of the Bosch board of management,” he says.

When Nicolly got one of the coveted apprenticeships out of 2,000 applications, her daughter was six months old. Her goal: she wants to her daughter a good future.

Between family life and programming

Mom and digital talent for smart automation — two vocations that Nicolly masters every day anew.

Nicolly lives with her parents, her three siblings, and her two-year-old daughter in Hortolândia, a small town near Campinas. In order to juggle both family and studies, her daily routine has to be well planned. Nicolly’s day therefore starts very early. She and her daughter get up at five o’clock. Shortly after six, she catches the company shuttle that takes her to the Bosch site. The trip itself takes about an hour. When the young Brazilian steps onto the company grounds, she’s no longer a single mother. Wearing her Bosch polo shirt as a school uniform, she’s a digital talent — one of 103 in the country. Bent over her laptop, she spends her time working with different programming languages and getting to grips with robotics and her specialist area of smart automation.

“Everybody gets the chance — regardless of their background, gender, or financial means.”

Nicolly’s focus in the training is intelligent process automation. Together with her fellow students, she enjoys everyday campus life and togetherness.

Now in her last semester, the 19-year-old is already working on her own projects in the Electrical Drives division. “At the moment, I’m looking at things like how Excel tables can be automated so that manual input is no longer necessary,” she explains. When she finishes her apprenticeship, there’s a good chance that she’ll be offered a permanent position in the division. All the graduates in the DTA’s first cohort received a job offer from Bosch. “I want to be able to offer my daughter a good future. My biggest wish is to buy my own apartment and car,” says Nicolly, when asked about her plans for the future. The battle for the best talent will then continue into the next round. The next group of 84 digital apprentices is already waiting in the wings for their start the following semester. “When looking to recruit the best software talent, Brazil should definitely be a port of call,” says Johnny Palma. “Our apprentices will do and develop things that we haven’t even dreamed of.”

Enfermeiro (a) Pleno - Unidade Neurológica / Hospital Vera Cruz

Join to apply for the Enfermeiro (a) Pleno - Unidade Neurológica / Hospital Vera Cruz role at Hospital Vera Cruz

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care. A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

title: Associate Product Operations Manager Campinas, Brazil
description:
About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

We are looking for an Associate Product Operations Manager to help evolve the way retailers operate within BEES. The Product Operations Team serves as a strategic partner to the Product organization, enabling efficiency, alignment, and operational excellence through well-designed processes, rituals, and data-driven insights.

Our mission is to support a winning product strategy and ensure best-in‑class digital product delivery that drives BEES’ commercial objectives. We do this by managing the product roadmap, building scalable processes, and strengthening cross‑functional collaboration across global teams and product areas.

This role sits within the Strategy & Operations group at BEES and will work closely with Product, Program, Engineering, and Commercial stakeholders across our worldwide ecosystem.

What you’ll do

  • Support the quarterly intake, prioritization, and roadmapping processes end‑to‑end, ensuring organizational alignment.
  • Manage and update roadmap changes throughout the quarter, maintaining communication with Product and Engineering teams.
  • Prepare materials, consolidate inputs, and support structured discussions for weekly problem‑statement reviews with Product & Engineering leadership.
  • Act as a support partner to Product Managers, ensuring initiatives, documentation, and JIRA items are complete and ready for strategic decision‑making.
  • Work closely with Commercial teams to operationalize business cases, validate commercial inputs, and ensure high‑quality information reaches Product for prioritization.
  • Support and prepare productization meetings with directors, ensuring clarity, consistent materials, and operational readiness.
  • Transform hypotheses into structured initiatives and facilitate alignment loops with senior leadership.
  • Maintain and evolve documentation in Confluence, ensuring accuracy and accessibility.
  • Build dashboards and reports to support leadership insights and product decision‑making.
  • Support change‑management initiatives and contribute to improving operational processes across the ecosystem.

What you’ll need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, Strategy, Project Management, or related fields.
  • Experience with project management, structured planning, and process organization.
  • Ability to analyze data and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Strong communication skills, including preparing presentations and engaging with senior stakeholders.
  • High attention to detail and strong organizational skills to manage diverse inputs and moving parts.
  • Interest in product strategy and understanding how commercial inputs connect to product decisions.
  • Ability to operate in a dynamic, non‑linear business environment with frequent changes.
  • Experience supporting operational rituals, documentation, and cross‑functional alignment (plus).
  • Tools: MS Office, JIRA, Confluence, Lucid tools, PowerBI.
  • Languages: Fluent English; Conversational Spanish is a plus.

What Makes This Role Challenging (and Exciting)

  • The BEES ecosystem is highly dynamic.
  • The scope is new within the team, offering autonomy, but also requiring comfort with ambiguity as processes mature.
  • You will interact with a wide range of product areas, understanding their quarterly plans and ensuring smooth operational alignment.
  • You will play a key role in ensuring that strategy reaches execution teams with clarity and structure.

What We Offer

  • Attendance Bonus*

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Marketing
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com o Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Elaboração do planejamento estratégico anual; Desenvolvimento e administração de orçamento anual;

  • Acompanhamento da evolução dos principais KPIs da área, com foco em otimização e rentabilização dos resultados;
  • Acompanhamento de parcerias estratégicas e desenvolvimento contínuo de melhores práticas e inovações do mercado;
  • Gerenciamento do planejamento, junto da agência de mídia nacional, das estratégias de mídia;
  • Acompanhamento de projetos especiais focados em implementação de novas frentes de trabalho, novos veículos, desenvolvimento de treinamento e mapeamento e implementação de melhorias dentro da vertical de mídia no shopping;
  • Gerenciamento da performance de mídia paga dos programas de benefícios do shopping, envolvendo definição de objetivos, estratégia, implementação, acompanhamento, relatório de resultados e KPIs estratégicos.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Desejável Pós-graduação correlacionada;
  • Vivência em gestão de campanhas (on e off);
  • Vivência em Gestão de Pessoas;

title: Enfermeiro(a) Oncológico / Centro de Oncologia Vera Cruz
description:
Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • A Enfermeira Navegadora Oncológica será responsável por
  • Realizar o acolhimento integral do paciente em todas as etapas do tratamento, estabelecendo uma relação de confiança e oferecendo suporte contínuo;
  • Atuar como elo entre os setores hospitalares e a clínica de oncologia, garantindo comunicação eficiente, organização dos fluxos e a integração das informações assistenciais.
  • Acompanhar diário do paciente internado;
  • Monitorar suas necessidades;
  • Orientar sobre procedimentos e etapas do tratamento, além do auxílio em processos administrativos;
  • Agendamentos, encaminhamentos e suporte às demandas da equipe multiprofissional.
  • Conduzir ou apoiar treinamentos específicos na área de oncologia, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento técnico da equipe e para a padronização de práticas seguras.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Possuir Graduação completa em Enfermagem;
  • Pós Graduação em Oncologia;
  • Possuir Coren ativo;
  • Experiência em setor Oncológico ou Clínica de Oncologia;
  • Conhecimentos sobre protocolos assistenciais e fluxos hospitalares.
  • Disponibilidade de horário 9:48 às 18:00 seg à sex.
  • Domínio de ferramentas administrativas e assistenciais, incluindo sistemas de prontuário eletrônico, planilhas e registros digitais que apoiem o acompanhamento do paciente.

title: KYC Analyst
description:
Marex Group plc is a diversified global financial services platform, providing essential liquidity, market access and infrastructure services to clients in the energy, commodities and financial markets. It listed on Nasdaq Global Select Market in April 2024. With more than 35 offices in Europe, US and APAC, it has unique access across markets with significant share globally both on and off exchange. The depth of knowledge amongst its teams and divisions provides its customers with clear advantage, and its technology‑led service provides access to all major exchanges, order‑flow management via screen, voice and DMA, plus award‑winning data, insights and analytics.

The Client Onboarding Department is responsible for conducting the process of identifying and verifying new customers. The team plays a key role in combatting financial crime and terrorist financing.

Role Summary

To ensure that customers across business divisions are on‑boarded efficiently and in accordance with Group policies and procedures.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure that appropriate CDD / KYC and AML checks are carried out on all new customers in accordance with local regulatory requirements and Group standards and procedures
  • Ensure that appropriate client documentation is issued to all new customers and in accordance with local regulatory and any exchange requirements
  • Ensure that appropriate customer categorisations are carried out in accordance with local regulatory requirements
  • Ensure daily targets set by the Onboarding Manager are met
  • Accurately update the customer pipeline on a daily basis (Neon Onboarding)
  • Ensure that client and static data is accurately input and maintained into the Client Data Base (PeopleSoft)
  • Ensure that complete records of all customer documentation are maintained
  • Ensure that the Front‑Office, Co‑Ordination Team and Quality Control Teams are advised of case progress
  • Issue client acceptance documentation and conduct account opening
  • Assist on any other ad‑hoc reviews/projects/audits that the Onboarding department is required to carry out
  • Efficiently dealing with general day‑to‑day ad‑hoc queries
  • Work closely with the Financial Crime team
  • Keeping management timely informed of issues/developments
  • Ensuring compliance with the company’s regulatory requirements
  • Adhere to the operational risk framework for your role ensuring that all regulatory or company determined parameters are complied with.
  • Role model for demonstrating highest level standards of integrity and conduct and reflecting Company Values.
  • At all times complying with Marex’s Code of Conduct
  • To ensure that you are fully aware of and adhere to internal policies that relate to you, your role or any other activities for which you have any level of responsibility
  • To report any breaches of policy to Compliance and/ or your supervisor as required
  • To elevate risk events immediately
  • To provide input to risk management processes, as required.

Skills and Experience

  • Experience in client onboarding, KYC and risk assessment of clients
  • Solid understanding of client categorisation
  • Worked in support of trading desks
  • Analytical skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience working in a regulated environment and knowledge of the risk and compliance requirements associated with this.
  • A collaborative team player, approachable, self‑efficient and influences a positive work environment
  • Resilient in a challenging, fast‑paced environment
  • Ability to work within a fast paced and high‑volume environment
  • Excels at building relationships, networking and influencing othersStrategic collaborator with insight and agility, able to anticipate future challenges, ensuring operational effectiveness

Conduct Rules

You must:

  • Act with integrity
  • Act with due skill, care and diligence
  • Be open and cooperative with the FCA, the PRA and other regulators
  • Pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly
  • Observe proper standard of market conduct

Company Values

Acting as a role model for the values of the Company:

Respect

Clients are at the heart of our business, with superior execution and superb client service the foundation of the firm. We respect our clients and always treat them fairly.

Integrity

Doing business the right way is the only way. We hold ourselves to a high ethical standard in everything we do – our clients expect this and we demand it of ourselves.

Collaborative

We work in teams – open and direct communication and the willingness to work hard and collaboratively are the basis for effective teamwork. Working well with others is necessary for us to succeed at what we do.

Developing our People

Our people are the basis of our competitive advantage. We look to “grow our own” and make Marex the place ambitious, hardworking, talented people choose to build their careers.

Adaptable and Nimble

Our size and flexibility is an advantage. We are big enough to support our client’s various needs, and adaptable and nimble enough to respond quickly to changing conditions or requirements. A non‑bureaucratic, but well controlled environment fosters initiative as well as employee satisfaction.

Marex is fully committed to the elimination of unlawful or unfair discrimination and values the differences that a diverse workforce brings to the company.

title: Arquiteto de Engenharia de Software
description:
Overview

Fazemos parte do Grupo BTG Pactual, maior banco de investimento da américa latina. Nosso propósito é transformar ativos desvalorizados no mercado de crédito e real estate. Atuamos na gestão de créditos inadimplentes corporativos, ajudando fundos, investidores, instituições financeiras e empresas a encontrarem soluções estratégicas para seus negócios. Isso é possível, devido às nossas 4 verticais: Créditos Inadimplidos Coorporativos (NPL), Ativos Imobiliários Estressados (DRE), Recuperação Judicial e Falência e Dívida Ativa.

Principais destaques

Alguns dos nossos destaques:

  • Somos um dos maiores resultados do Grupo BTG Pactual.
  • Crescemos, em média, 20% ao ano.
  • Contamos com a ATENA, nossa IA que otimiza a rotina e potencializa análises.

Nossa comunidade é formada por 300 colaboradores e 170 parceiros, que atuam com proatividade, inovação, excelência, senso de dono e foco no cliente. Em um ambiente que valoriza o empreendedorismo, a meritocracia e o foco no cliente, promovemos uma cultura de resultados e crescimento profissional contínuo.

Utilizamos banco de dados PostgreSQL e com micro serviços desenvolvidos em Python (flask) e frontend em Angular. Toda nossa estrutura é “dockerizada” rodando em kubernetes e integrada utilizando tópicos (SNS) e filas (SQS). Também fazemos uso do Elasticsearch para otimizar nossas consultas. Tudo sendo provido pela AWS. Também temos toda uma esteira de CI/CD com testes automatizados provido pela Microsoft Azure Devops.

Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter microsserviços em Python (Flask ou FastAPI), garantindo alta performance, segurança e escalabilidade;
  • Contribuir para a arquitetura técnica e para o desenho de soluções que traduzam demandas de negócio em sistemas robustos e eficientes;
  • Implantar integrações e automações utilizando o ecossistema AWS (EventBridge, SQS, RDS, Lambda, S3, entre outros);
  • Atuar na observabilidade e sustentação de aplicações em ambiente Kubernetes, com foco em confiabilidade e resiliência;
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (produto, dados e negócios) para evoluir continuamente a plataforma tecnológica da Enforce;
  • Participar ativamente de decisões técnicas e estratégicas de arquitetura e infraestrutura.

Requisitos

  • +8 anos de experiência em engenharia de software, utilizamos Python e frameworks modernos (Flask, FastAPI ou similares) mas caso você venha do Java e tenha desejo de trabalhar com nossa stack não será problema;
  • Vivência em ambientes baseados em microsserviços e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Experiência sólida com AWS (preferencialmente EventBridge, SQS, Lambda, RDS e S3);
  • Conhecimentos em orquestração de containers com Kubernetes;
  • Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas de alta qualidade;
  • Perfil colaborativo, com iniciativa e foco em resultados.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em sistemas financeiros, gestão de crédito ou recuperação de ativos;
  • Conhecimento em pipelines de dados e automação de processos complexos;
  • Familiaridade com práticas DevOps e CI/CD.
  • Plano Médico e Odontológico Bradesco;
  • Cartão Flash (VA/VR e auxílio flexível);
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados anual;
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass );
  • Programa de Capacitação (Auxílio educação);

Aqui, o aprendizado é constante: a cada novo ativo adquirido, você estará imerso em um processo dinâmico de identificação de problemas e criação de estratégias eficazes. Aqui você terá a oportunidade de transformar mercados, impulsionar grandes projetos e crescer profissionalmente em um ambiente enérgico e colaborativo.

Somos apaixonados por pensar fora da caixa para encontrar soluções inovadoras e buscamos profissionais que compartilhem do mesmo entusiasmo por fazer a diferença. #VemSerEnforce.

Education and Experience

Senior Product Designer - Performance & Ongoing Operations

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What you\'ll do:

  • Collaborate & Influence: Partner with engineering, product management, and commercial teams to define and execute a shared vision for our digital experience.
  • Lead UX Strategy: Own your squad’s product design roadmap , shaping customer journey maps, user flows, and service blueprints to guide impactful solutions.
  • Design & Deliver: Drive end-to-end design execution—from early discovery and prototyping to shipping products and iterating based on feedback.
  • Facilitate & Align: Lead workshops, discovery sessions, and critiques to bring stakeholders into the design process, aligning on challenges and opportunities.
  • Advocate for the User: Champion user needs throughout the product development lifecycle, balancing business goals with a great customer experience.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Graphic Design, Digital Design, Visual Design, Product Design, or Industrial Design.
  • Strong communicator & storyteller – You can articulate design decisions clearly, influence stakeholders, and present ideas effectively in English.
  • Proven experience shipping digital products – You’ve worked in cross-functional teams, using iterative processes with both qualitative and quantitative insights.
  • Systems thinker with a tactical mindset – You can zoom out to see the bigger picture but also execute with precision at a detailed level.
  • Experience with UX research & strategy – You proactively uncover problems worth solving and ensure the team stays focused on the right challenges.

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços. Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro. Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento. Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

title: Structured Products Operations Analyst
description:
Marex Group plc (NASDAQ: MRX) is a diversified global financial services platform providing essential liquidity, market access and infrastructure services to clients across energy, commodities and financial markets. The group provides comprehensive breadth and depth of coverage across four core services: clearing, agency and execution, market making, and hedging and investment solutions. It has a leading franchise in many major metals, energy and agricultural products, with access to 60 exchanges. The group provides access to the world’s major commodity markets, covering a broad range of clients that include some of the largest commodity producers, consumers and traders, banks, hedge funds and asset managers. With more than 40 offices worldwide, the group has over 2,300 employees across Europe, Asia and the Americas.

Marex Solutions, a division of Marex, is a specialist producer of tailored OTC derivatives and structured products. We are a highly entrepreneurial and fast growing manufacturer, trader and service provider of customised derivative solutions. We design and implement solutions to mitigate against market risks or to create investment opportunities. We leverage cutting edge technology to empower our customers and disrupt traditional investment banking practices.

To provide front to back operational support to the Structured Product business and its customers.

Overall Responsibilities

• A key member of the operations team providing comprehensive support to OTC Derivatives and Structured Notes business of Marex Solutions front office and clients. Report and escalate issues timely to the Head of the team as well as relevant senior management of the Desk.
• Daily BAU activities include, but not limited to, reconciling trade positions and cash flows, managing trade and notes lifecycles, sending trade confirmations and client statements, dealing with margin calls, paying agent, prime brokerage and settlements, as well as making sure all relevant trades are reported correctly to meet MiFID, EMIR and Dodd-Frank regulatory frameworks.
• Contributing to the establishment of new controls, enhancement and automation of existing reconciliation tools and processes
• Work closely and partner with finance, treasury, risk, audit and compliance departments
• Maintain detailed operating procedures for the team and train new joiners to ensure business continuity and minimise staff risk

Skills and Experience

• Adept across the MS Office suite (the ability to write macros/VBA and Python is highly desirable)
• Keen to work in a rapidly evolving and growing organisation and make your mark, highly committed
• Up to 3 years relevant experience* in a similar middle office/operations role in financial service industry desirable but not compulsory.
• Problem solving skills
• A meticulous eye for detail
• The ability to work effectively under pressure in a busy environment
• Experience working in a regulated environment and knowledge of the risk and compliance requirements associated with this.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills
• A collaborative team player, approachable, self-efficient and influences a positive work environment
• Demonstrates curiosity
• Resilient in a challenging, fast-paced environment
• Excels at building relationships, networking and influencing others
• Strategic collaborator with insight and agility, able to anticipate future challenges, ensuring operational effectiveness

E para isso, buscamos atender as necessidades de nossos parceiros e principalmente, todos os nossos colaboradores – e quando falamos “todos”, não existe exceção!

Nossos serviços diários são voltados para pessoas e realizados por pessoas. Então, pensando em gerar oportunidades mais inclusivas, criamos este banco de talentos focado em diversidade. Temos um caminho pela frente, mas sabemos que juntos, podemos fortalecer ainda mais nossa cultura de inclusão e fazer da Brasanitas um local acolhedor, plural e cheio de personalidade.

Estamos presentes em empresas de diferentes segmentos como indústrias, hospitais, laboratórios, shoppings centers, instituições de ensino, mineradoras e redes de varejo.

Cultivamos a inovação! Atentos às tendências, estamos constantemente transformando nossas ideias e aprimorando os processos. Aplicamos novas tecnologias em nossa comunicação, operações e metodologias com o objetivo de realizar as atividades com mais segurança e maior integração.

Valorizamos as diferenças! Somos feitos de diversidade com muitos rostos, culturas, cores e gêneros. Todos são bem-vindos, sem exceção, e agregam ainda mais valor a este grande time.

Venha fazer parte de uma empresa com propósito, que atua com excelência e qualidade reconhecida pelos nossos clientes.

Criamos soluções personalizadas para atender às necessidades específicas de treinamento de equipes, criação de conteúdo criativo e tradução para ambientes corporativos. Vamos além do convencional, oferecendo soluções sob medida. Com um forte foco na entrega de valor, contamos com profissionais que não apenas executam tarefas, mas também superam desafios, impulsionam a inovação, promovem a colaboração e entregam excelência para cada cliente. Na Netwire Global, acreditamos na igual importância de nossos clientes, funcionários, fornecedores, acionistas, parceiros e da própria organização.

Como Analista de Gestão de Fornecedores você irá:

Expandir e fortalecer a rede de fornecedores da Netwire Global, construindo relações sólidas com profissionais parceiros estratégicos do negócio. Recrutar, homologar, acompanhar desempenho e manter banco de talentos atualizado, promovendo o uso eficiente de recursos externos nas diferentes frentes da operação. Apoiar o setor de Recursos Humanos nos processos de recrutamento e seleção, garantindo sinergia entre cultura, qualidade e inovação.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, gerenciar e manter todo o processo de recrutamento, seleção e homologação de fornecedores externos;
  • Apoiar pontualmente o RH em processos seletivos internos, quando necessário, contribuindo com etapas como triagem, entrevistas ou testes;

  • Desenvolver relacionamento contínuo com todos os fornecedores, promovendo engajamento e fidelização;
  • Apoiar a operação na antecipação de demandas e dimensionamento da rede de fornecedores para diferentes tipos de projetos;
  • Aplicar testes, validar competências e monitorar qualidade e prazos de entrega dos fornecedores homologados;
  • Negociar taxas competitivas e propor condições vantajosas com base em volume e perfil dos projetos;
  • Realizar pesquisas de mercado para compreender valores e taxas que são praticados fora da Netwire Global;
  • Garantir a compra estratégica de serviços pela equipe interna da Netwire Global, incluindo cotações de tradução juramentada e relacionamento com fornecedores especializados nesse serviço;
  • Ser apoio da área Comercial na precificação de serviços;
  • Ser apoio da área de Service Engineering na definição de tabela de preços para otimização do processo de cotação;
  • Manter banco de dados atualizado com informações completas sobre os fornecedores;
  • Acompanhar os fornecedores recém homologados e garantir que estão aptos a receberem demandas das áreas operacionais;
  • Promover o uso estratégico de fornecedores homologados que ainda não foram ativados;
  • Representar a Netwire Global em eventos e oportunidades de networking relevantes para o negócio;
  • Organizar ou apoiar eventos online com foco em fortalecer a imagem institucional e relacionamento com a rede de fornecedores;
  • Buscar constantemente melhorias e inovações nos processos de R&S e relacionamento com terceiros;
  • Compreender os serviços oferecidos pela Netwire Global e as necessidades operacionais de cada área;
  • Monitorar e gerar alertas sobre desempenho e confiabilidade de fornecedores, contribuindo com decisões operacionais.
  • Monitorar e apresentar resultados mensais da área para a liderança.

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Designer (Senior) to join our Shopping Journey team. You’ll be responsible for designing user-centered experiences that drive real impact across the shopping experience, from discovery to post-sales. If you enjoy thinking strategically, creating scalable solutions, and collaborating with other designers to deliver simple, efficient, and inclusive experiences, this role is for you. You’ll work closely with experienced designers in an agile environment, with room to propose, test, and deliver solutions at scale.

What you'll do:

  • Lead end-to-end design processes, from discovery through delivery.
  • Map and design journeys within the shopping ecosystem, focusing on usability, clarity, and conversion.
  • Create flows, prototypes, and interfaces based on data, research, and usability best practices, drawing from sources like Baymard Institute and Nielsen Norman Group.
  • Participate and lead discovery workshops and co-creation dynamics to map opportunities and prioritize solutions.
  • Support definition of success metrics and hypothesis validation.
  • Collaborate with UX Writing, UX Research, Product, and Engineering to ensure cohesive solutions.
  • Defend design decisions using strong rationale grounded in user needs and business impact.
  • Contribute to and evolve the design system with scalable, consistent, and accessible components.
  • Take part in design rituals like critiques, reviews, and feedback sessions.

What you'll need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Graphic Design, Digital Design, Visual Design, Product Design, or Industrial Design.
  • Hands-on experience as a Product Designer delivering end-to-end digital products (web and/or mobile).
  • Solid understanding of UX, UI, prototyping, and usability best practices.
  • Proficiency with Figma and familiarity with tools like Lucidchart, Maze, or similar.
  • Ability to clearly articulate and defend design decisions using data, benchmarks, and empathy for diverse audiences.
  • Experience working in agile environments, collaborating with Product, Engineering, and other Designers.
  • Advanced English for documentation and occasional global collaboration.
  • Experience in B2B, marketplace, e-commerce, or large-scale platforms.

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with discovery frameworks, product metrics, and A/B testing.
  • Knowledge of accessibility and inclusive design principles.

More about you:

  • A curious mindset and investigative approach to deeply understand problems before solving them.
  • Clear and effective communication across different formats and audiences.
  • Proactive attitude to suggest improvements, test ideas, and learn from outcomes.
  • Genuine collaboration with active listening and respect for diverse perspectives.
  • Attention to visual consistency and detail, with ownership of the impact delivered.
  • Interest in growing within a team that values excellence, autonomy, and continuous learning.

Auxilia na disseminação da cultura Lean, disseminando o pilar de Qualidade entre todos os integrantes do time e em todas as etapas do processo de desenvolvimento do time em que estiver inserido.

Defende a cultura de Qualidade e contribui para que todos os integrantes do time se sintam responsáveis pela qualidade em todas as etapas do processo de desenvolvimento, de acordo com suas atribuições.

Contribui com novas ideias e melhorias que visam melhorar a qualidade dos processos realizados pelo time.

Responsabilidades

Identificar em cada demanda de desenvolvimento quais tipos e técnicas de testes são apropriados para serem aplicados, para assegurar que os sistemas desenvolvidos pela empresa possuem uma boa cobertura de testes e que as entregas estejam adequadas.

  • Validar regras de negócio dos sistemas, comprovar a correção de bugs, identificar possíveis riscos e inconsistências nos sistemas visando a prevenção de problemas futuros.
  • Ter boa capacidade de leitura e interpretação de texto para compreender cada demanda de desenvolvimento.
  • Participar de forma ativa de reuniões de planejamento e refinamento, além dos eventos do Scrum, contribuindo com a visão de Qualidade sobre os assuntos que estiverem sendo discutidos.

Analisar e identificar quando uma nova demanda realmente faz sentido para o produto ou quando ela talvez precise ser revista, por quaisquer motivos que sejam, desde uma história vagamente escrita, um fluxo incompleto, dentre outros.

  • Descrever problemas encontrados durante os testes de forma simples, objetiva, isenta, sem julgamentos e sem dupla interpretação.
  • Reportar bugs e melhorias de forma eficiente, onde esteja claro para o desenvolvedor e todo o time qual o problema e a melhor maneira de reproduzi-lo.

  • Realizar pair programming junto aos desenvolvedores para aplicar a cultura de qualidade em testes unitários, processos e melhorias, além de prevenir práticas que possam prejudicar a qualidade dos sistemas e processos.
  • Analisar os resultados de cada entrega e reconhecer padrões de problemas/dificuldades que o time apresenta no desenvolvimento do sistema para que possam ser melhorados ao longo do tempo.
  • Analisar o processo de desenvolvimento em que está inserido e conseguir entender eventuais falhas que possam prejudicar a entrega do produto, prevenindo assim, novos problemas futuros.
  • Participar de entrevistas técnicas para a contratação de novos QAs.
  • Aprender novas tecnologias e aplicar novos processos de testes quando for necessário e quando se aplicar ao contexto de trabalho em que estiver inserido.

Competências Técnicas

  • Graduação completa em Análise de Sistemas, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas afins.
  • Processos Ágeis (cultura Lean, Scrum/Kanban), Tipos de Teste (caixa branca, caixa preta, regressão), Técnicas de Teste (valor limite, tabela de decisão, transição de estado), Gitflow, CI/CD.

NetCracker Technology is seeking a Senior OSS Business Analyst with strong expertise in the OSS, particularly in Resource Inventory and Service Orchestration for different Telecom domains – IP/MPLS, DWDM, MW for B2B and B2C services as well as the Data Migration aspect of those. In this role, you will act as a customer‑facing expert, driving the identification of solution and product requirements throughout the analysis, design, implementation, training, migration, and testing phases of projects.

Role & Responsibilites

  • Identify, collect, clarify, and organize functional requirements for new solution features and change requests
  • Develop system use cases and information models for product, service, and resource management domains within OSS/BSS products
  • Design solution components, including object models, flows, user interfaces, and integration interfaces
  • Configure products to meet specific customer requirements and ensure proper solution delivery
  • Validate customer business needs and drive improvements in existing products and solutions
  • Capture and share best practices to support pre‑sales activities and solution positioning
  • Contribute across the delivery lifecycle, participating in analysis, design, prototyping, proof‑of‑concept, acceptance, and implementation projects
  • Perform gap analysis and define new user scenarios for out‑of‑the‑box (OOB) solutions in domains such as: Network planning, design, and build‑out, Network maintenance, upgrade, and decommissioning, Service design and activation, Network operations and maintenance
  • Conduct market and technology research in the telecommunications industry, learning standards in OSS/BSS, Network Automation and Orchestration
  • Participate in the development of new modules and components
  • Prepare data mapping and data validation documentation within the scope of ETL processes

Required Experience

  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills
  • Excellent skills in object‑oriented design (generalization, classification, decomposition, correlation, unification, decision tables)
  • University technical degree (maths, physics, IT, telecommunications, programming)
  • Experience in software product development and implementation (telecommunications domain preferred)
  • Understanding of network architecture and functionality of core/transport, access, and overlay/virtualization networks
  • Experience in OSS fulfillment and assurance processes for services and resources for one or several of the following: IP, Carrier Ethernet, SD‑WAN, GPON
  • Knowledge of UML or other object modeling notations and practical use of data modeling tools
  • Solid knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases
  • Understanding of OSS/BSS frameworks and telecom standards: TMF, ETSI, ITU, 3GPP, IETF, MEF, ONAP
  • Understanding of network management protocols and languages: YANG, REST, gRPC, gNMI, NETCONF, SNMP, CLI
  • Good knowledge of SQL
  • Experience using JSON for data exchange is a plus
  • Understanding of REST services is a plus
  • Understanding of software development lifecycles (RUP, Agile, etc)
  • Good technical English writing and communication skills
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in senior network engineering or analytical roles
  • Availability to work from the office on a Hybrid mode from either our São Paulo or Campinas offices

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Maths, Physics or related field

title: Experienced UVM Verification Engineer
description:
Are you willing to participate in the development of a human size growing team?

Aedvices specializes in ICs, FPGAs and embedded systems Front-End Digital Design and Design Verification. We provide flexible solutions to our customers, ranging from turnkey design and verification options to dedicated consulting in design or verification as well as training solutions.

Our customer base spans from large semiconductor groups to small tech startups.

We support a wide range of projects in the automotive, big-data, artificial intelligence and energy sectors, such as the verification of the telemetry system of a Mars probe / Mars tremors or the verification of a System-on-Chip for Bluetooth Low Energy.

To sustain our growth, we are looking for several experienced verification engineers to join the team.

Your main responsibilities

As a key member of the verification team, you will define the verification methodologies and adapt them to the project requirements. You will be responsible for the verification of complex IPs and System-On-Chips, the development of verification environments (SystemVerilog/UVM/other), UVM verification IPs (VIPs), and the writing of verification plans.

You propose improvements to existing flows. You will also have the opportunity to work with colleagues in France and with our partners on innovative approaches and methodologies (formal methods, PSS).

Is the job right for you?

To carry out your missions, you need to master several essential technical topics:

  • Functional verification at IP level and of complex SoC,
  • SystemVerilog testbench and UVM core development,
  • Development of verification plans,
  • AMBA protocols,
  • Embedded software development (C, C++),
  • Knowledge of RTL design languages: VHDL, Verilog,
  • Written and spoken English.

Other skills welcome:

  • Object Oriented Programming,
  • Advanced protocols such as PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, Bluetooth, …
  • ASIC and FPGA design,
  • Scripting (Python).

For an efficient and fruitful collaboration, we expect you to:

  • Have an engineering background or equivalent, and at least 5 years’ experience in verification,
  • Be able to balance perfectionism and pragmatism!
  • Be eager to learn new things, grow your skills and elaborate creative technical solutions,
  • Be able to work in a team,
  • Think “problem solving” and think “out of the box”,
  • And last but not least: be committed to customers’ satisfaction.

What we offer you

  • Continue to develop your expertise with the access of all our training materials,
  • Join a friendly company who share values of Diversity, Conviviality, Technical Expertise and Passion,
  • Benefit from a flexible organization with the possibility of remote work,
  • Full time contract,
  • Additional benefits such as meal voucher and dental health.

Want to join us?

Our recruitment process is simple:

After an initial call, you’ll meet with Agnès, our HR Manager, and Eric, our Verification Technical Director.

If your expectations match ours, the recruitment process concludes with a meeting with Fabio, our Brazil director.

title: Product Security Engineer
description:
Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you’re interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Overview

As a Product Security Engineer at Toradex, you’ll be responsible for the implementation, validation, and maintenance of security features in Toradex’s embedded software stack. That means hands‑on, low‑level work with bootloaders, Linux kernel security features, secure software updates and more.

We aim to make embedded software development easy and approachable, which means that our engineers have to go beyond just feature enablement. Your work will involve making the developer experience of working with low‑level security features as smooth as it possibly can be. You’ll work on systems used in critical industries like healthcare, industrial automation, and robotics.

Responsibilities

  • Security feature enablement: Bring up security features on new hardware. Every new product we release, we strive to have a uniform, straightforward experience for enabling basic hardware security features like secure boot, ARM TrustZone/ OP-TEE , and hardware‑backed encryption.
  • System-level hardening: Toradex maintains Torizon OS, a secure, production‑ready embedded Linux OS. Making sure that security features fit into the whole stack, and that configurations are secure‑by‑default for the most common and supported workflows is a key part of the job. description:
Join to apply for the Técnico (a) em Radiologia / Clinica Imagem Vera Cruz role at Hospital Vera Cruz

Sobre o Hospital

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI. Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba. Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care. A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos. Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar exames de radiologia convencional, tomografia computadorizada, ressonância magnética e outros procedimentos de imagem conforme protocolos estabelecidos;
  • Garantir qualidade técnica dos exames, a segurança do paciente e o cumprimento das normas de radioproteção;
  • Atuar junto com equipe multiprofissional;
  • Preparar e posicionar pacientes para a realização dos exames;
  • Operar equipamentos de imagem digital e sistemas PACS/RIS;
  • Cumprir normas de segurança e radioproteção, zelando pelo uso adequado dos EPIs e EPCs de radiologia (avental plumbífero, protetores etc.);
  • Manter organização e conservação dos equipamentos e salas de exame;
  • Prestar atendimento humanizado aos pacientes e acompanhantes.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação Técnica em Radiologia completa;
  • Registro ativo no CRTR;
  • Conhecimentos em equipamentos digitais (CR/DR), tomografia computadorizada, ressonância magnética e sistemas de informática na saúde;
  • Desejável experiência prévia em hospital/clínica de diagnóstico por imagem;
  • Desejável familiaridade e/ou experiência com Ressonância Magnética;

Buscamos alguém comunicativo(a), colaborativo(a) e com maturidade técnica para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, que valoriza transparência, autonomia, responsabilidade e tomada de decisão. Queremos pessoas que gostem de desafios, tenham vontade de aprender, evoluir e trabalhar em um time engajado, entregando valor real para nossos clientes.

Principais atividades e desafios

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e manter aplicações backend utilizando Kotlin e Spring.
  • Participar de discussões técnicas, propondo soluções, melhorias e boas práticas de engenharia.
  • Integrar aplicações com APIs externas e sistemas internos.
  • Atuar em aplicações monolíticas e/ou ambientes de microserviços.
  • Trabalhar com mensageria assíncrona e arquitetura orientada a eventos, utilizando ferramentas como Kafka, Pub/Sub, SQS e RabbitMQ.
  • Garantir qualidade de código, padronização e evolução constante de práticas internas.
  • Contribuir em decisões arquiteturais, priorizando escalabilidade, segurança e manutenção.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores(as) menos experientes e apoiar revisões de código.
  • Acompanhar monitoramento, performance e confiabilidade das aplicações.
  • Demonstrar proficiência em testes, boas práticas de versionamento e documentação de APIs.

Abertura para outras stacks

Profissionais de outras stacks com domínio de Orientação a Objetos e interesse em migrar para Kotlin/Spring também são muito bem-vindos — valorizamos fundamentos sólidos acima de tecnologias específicas.

Requisitos essenciais

  • Domínio sobre Orientação a Objetos.
  • Banco de dados (relacionais e/ou não relacionais).
  • Mensageria (Kafka, Pub/Sub, SQS e RabbitMQ).
  • Proficiência em Docker.
  • Experiência com testes.

Diferenciais (Não eliminatórios)

  • Experiência full stack com tecnologias front-end baseadas em componentes (React, Vue, Angular).
  • Certificações técnicas relacionadas a backend, cloud ou arquitetura.
  • Conhecimento básico de arquitetura de software (DDD, hexagonal, camadas etc.).
  • Forte comunicação, clareza e postura consultiva/questionadora.
  • Projetos pessoais ou contribuições relevantes em Open Source.
  • Experiência prévia em ambientes de alta escala.
  • Inglês e/ou espanhol técnico em nível básico.

title: Automation QA Engineer
description:
BRP is looking for a skilled QA Automation Engineer to join its dynamic and growing Digital Customer Experience Testing and Quality Assurance Engineering team. As a Digital QA Specialist, you will be able to demonstrate your talents and enjoy working on a variety of digital projects (E-Commerce D2C) in a fast-paced and agile environment.

You will define and execute unit, regression, system integration test and smoke test cases, ensuring the quality and responsiveness of our digital technology platforms alongside a talented and passionate development team working on a vast array of systems.

YOU'LL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO:

  • Design, write, and maintain automated test cases using Cypress
  • Build and improve the test automation framework
  • Work closely with developers, product owners to define, design, and ship new features
  • Actively participate in the testing of digital properties and applications, its subsystems, interface (API), and its supporting technical infrastructure
  • Analyze project documentation to determine test case and script design, participate in test execution and defect resolution
  • Define test strategy, test approach, and test environment requirements
  • Design and prepare test data
  • Create test plans, innovative test cases, release notes, test logs, etc., based on requirements and test execution
  • Maintain QA documents up-to-date across sprints
  • Report test results, logs, and defects clearly and effectively
  • Suggest ways to improve QA practices and implement them

YOU’LL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE THE FOLLOWING SKILLS AND QUALITIES:

  • Worked in a QA capacity for 3+ years or more
  • 3+ years practical experience with IT principles, theory and methodologies
  • 3+ years proven track record in participating and executing test plans, including analysis, sprint, design and execution
  • Experience with Cypress, Playwright, Gherkin & TestRail
  • Proficient in JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Strong understanding of e-commerce flows in an agile environment is an asset
  • Experience in API and UI (Accessibility is a plus) E-commerce within Magento (plus)
  • Excellent analysis and problem-solving skills
  • Should be a team player who works with a sense of urgency towards timelines
  • Adaptable and flexible, takes ownership, transparent and proactive
  • Customer service focus and relationship management skills
  • Post-secondary school education in Computer Science
  • Experience in an Agile Environment (Scrum, Kanban)
  • Fluent English

WELCOME TO BRP

We’re a world leader in recreational vehicles and boats, creating innovative ways to move on snow, water, asphalt, dirt, and even in the air. Headquartered in the Canadian town of Valcourt, Quebec, our company is rooted in a spirit of ingenuity and intense customer focus. Today, we operate manufacturing facilities in Canada, the United States, Mexico, Finland, Australia and Austria, with a workforce made up of close to 20,000 spirited people, all driven by the deeply held belief that at work, as with life itself, it’s not about the destination; It’s about the journey. Yours.

This position is based in Campinas, Brazil and is eligible to the BRP Employee Referral Program.

Resumes in English will be preferred.

You will have the opportunity to work in hybrid mode, 2 to 3 days in the office.
